$description: ShopBase 2.0 Home (P01) primitive tokens. Raw values only, neutral names. Source: 06-proof-ui/proof.html :root (Gate 6 APPROVED) and 03-research/16-palette.md (Option 1 LOCKED + Amendment). Light mode only. Dimension values are strings with a unit (older DTCG draft form). NON-STANDARD uses, kept on purpose so the values equal the proof: the angle (135deg) is typed dimension, the grid templates are typed string (not a DTCG type), letter spacing is in em (DTCG dimension allows px and rem only), and shadow offsetX/spread are written as unitless 0 as in the proof. Unitless ratios use number, which is standard.

600.$description: Logo blue scaled to 92% brightness, hue 220. White on it is 4.69:1.

700.$description: Darker step of the same hue.

600.$description: Darker mid cool grey, between 500 and 700 in lightness.

800.$description: Near-black, same as the dark logo wordmark.

700.$description: Thin margin on its tint (4.72:1): do not lighten either.

sans.$description: Inter first, then the proof's fallback stack. Inter file: 02-assets/fonts/InterVariable.woff2 (weights 100 to 900).

scale.$description: Type scale ratio from 1rem; one step down (1/1.25 = 0.8rem) for captions.

space.$description: Spacing scale, ratio about 1.6 from 4px; the top step (7) is the section gap in the proof.

radius.$description: Named by pixel value at 16px root.

992.$description: Pill: larger than any element height.

soft.$description: Soft card shadow (white card on a field). Colour is #1E222B (neutral.900) at 10%.

lifted.$description: Device wrapper shadow (proof wrapper). Colour is #1E222B (neutral.900) at 16%.

135.$description: Field gradient angle. DTCG has no angle type; dimension used.

size.$description: Layout sizes, named by pixel value at 16px root.

120.$description: Logo width in the proof legend; equals the 120px minimum full-logo width proposed in 04-brand/10-identity.md.

0945.$description: Named by value (0.0945 = 24 / 254). Used for the logo clear space: proof calc(logo-w * 0.0945); 04-brand/10-identity.md: 24 / 254 = 0.0945.

5-7.$description: Text column then visual column. Not a DTCG type.

7-5.$description: Visual column then text column (reverse rows).

breakpoint.$description: Values from the proof's media queries (not :root variables).

1439.$description: Compact desktop rules apply at max-width 1439px.

375.$description: Mobile design width used by the proof (not a media query).
